page.layout: One column of names, each line with a year printed in the left margin beside it. Right margin: printed notes beside the 1479, 1481, 1482 and 1483 groups. Page number at the head.

main_text.l: 1479 | Sweder Cater. Arnoldus Lovs legatus Cæf. Groningæ,& in Frisia occid.
1481 | Johan Tedema. Diploma Cæsaris luculentissimum pro Groninganis à Loo allatum, signatum anno priore: quo munus gubernationis per Frisiam occid. iis commissum.
1482 | Herman Potter. Fœdus celeberrimum & ultimum inter civitatem Gron. & ordines agrarios in annos XL. Pactum cum VVestergois.
1483 | Roleff Ulgers, Pactum civitaris cum Monasteriensibus de derivando Amafo.

page.notes: The years 1478–1484 stand in the left margin between the name lines; I attached each to the nearest line, so their exact line alignment is approximate. The printed "Groningæ" in the first margin note is hard to read and may be "Groningæ" or similar; marked as read. The margin note "Amafo" may be "Amasfo"; I followed the scan as "Amafo." Printing error "Gofen" for "Gosen" is possible but left as printed. Hyphenated line-end words in the margin notes were joined ("Fri-sia", "luculen-tissimum", "com-missum", "deri-vando").
